metadata.description: Tools for running a team of Claude Code sessions: an orchestrator, lanes, and clean handoffs between them.

plugins.name: agent-boss
plugins.description: Orchestrator and lane handoffs for multi-session Claude Code work: roles held by session ID, handoff checks, and fresh lane sessions.

plugins.name: doc-index
plugins.description: Make a project's own writing reachable by a session: a one-line-per-document index, a searchable index of documents, notes, issues and decisions served over MCP, and an agent that keeps both true.

plugins.name: soda-fountain
plugins.description: Query US city, county and state open data on Socrata portals. Starts the soda-fountain MCP server and teaches Claude the discover, schema, SoQL workflow, cross-dataset keys and error handling.
